summary: Frontend-only testing of the new WhatsApp admin panel. All flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: login as super-admin, WhatsApp tab visible, 4 sub-tabs present, Config save+persist with masked password on reload, Send Test executes without crash, Templates lists all 8 templates and edit-save-persist works (verified by re-loading tab), Broadcast returns graceful summary text, Logs table renders (1 row from test send attempt) and Refresh works. Cleanup completed: WhatsApp disabled and BhashSMS user cleared.

issues: Test-send result text renders as a small muted line inline in the config card; it is easy to miss and can scroll out of view when other fields are long. Consider using an alert-style banner (like Save success) or scrolling to it on response.

critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppPanel.jsx line 253 uses r._id as React key when rendering log rows; response strips ObjectId elsewhere so ensure backend consistently returns a stable string id (id vs _id) - currently working but brittle.
ConfigTab save success re-uses .alert-success but doesn't auto-clear; a stale 'Settings saved.' banner stays visible when user later edits fields. Minor UX polish.
LogsTab Refresh button has no data-testid, making automation slightly harder (works via class selector today).
seed_data_creation: None. Config was toggled during test and reset to disabled+empty user at the end. One WhatsApp log row was created by the 'Send Test' action (expected failure).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp admin panel is fully wired. Cleanup left config disabled with empty BhashSMS user. One log entry exists from the test send attempt. Sub-tabs are DIVs with data-testid wa-subtab-{key}. Broadcast triggers a window.confirm dialog - auto-accept it in Playwright with page.on('dialog', ...).
